---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an enhancement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: Orpere
---

**Problem**
What pain does this solve? (If there's no pain, it may be out of scope.)

**Proposed solution**
How would kindboard behave after the change?

**Alternatives considered**
Why not a simpler approach, or a different one?

**Scope check** (helps triage):
- [ ] Fits the existing architecture (core = risky logic, app = UI) — see docs/architecture.md
- [ ] Needs no new pinned-and-verified downloads
- [ ] Can be covered by unit tests without a live cluster
